title: Undo and redo for the editor
acceptance: Undo/redo of insert, paste, replace-selection, deleteBackward and deleteForward restoring text and selection; typing groups with the 1000 ms boundary (999 merges, 1000 does not), continuous typing, newline and multi-character inserts, groups closed by select/delete/undo/redo/transact even when nothing changes; redo cleared by new steps but not by no-op edits or select; transactions with before/after selection, nesting, no-op transactions, rollback and rethrow on error with redo intact, undo inside a transaction throws; history limit discarding oldest, limit 0, RangeError for invalid limits; boolean returns of undo/redo.
difficulty_rationale: Stateful feature across three files with interacting rules (time-based grouping, group closing, redo invalidation, nested and failing transactions, history limit) that a first attempt rarely gets fully right.
